metadata.title: Qhapaq
metadata.description: Qhapaq — verifiable participation in real-world projects.

qrp.description: QRP represents your participation in this project within Qhapaq. The amount of QRP you have indicates your participation in the project.
qrp.brief: QRP is the unit that represents your participation in this project.

stellar.description: Stellar is the public network where Qhapaq records your participation so it can be checked openly. Think of it as a shared notebook that keeps a clear, lasting record.
stellar.brief: Stellar is the public network that keeps an open record of your participation.

project.heroLead: A coastal hospitality project where you can participate and unlock clear benefits.
project.overviewTitle: Verifiable participation in a coastal resort
project.shortDescription: A coastal hospitality project inviting the community to participate and unlock verifiable benefits.

overview.p1: Huaral Resort brings guests a calm Pacific retreat north of Lima — pools, dining, and wellness spaces designed for long stays and local weekends.
overview.p2: With Qhapaq you can acquire participation in this project. Your participation is measured in QRP and recorded in a verifiable way. This is not shares or an investment product.
overview.p3: Participating unlocks a 20% discount on resort services — a concrete benefit you can generate, verify, and use.

discount.title: Resort services discount
discount.description: Participants receive 20% off lodging, dining, and spa services when visiting Huaral Resort.

priority.title: Priority booking window
priority.description: Early access to seasonal packages and peak-weekend reservations before general release.

project.disclaimer: This is a demonstration of verifiable participation. QRP is not a security, equity share, or investment product.
